entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand. It's not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The thing won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I've charged it, reinstalled the app... nothing. I think the unit is just broken.
I see. A device that won't sync is definitely a frustrating experience. It sounds like you've already done some good troubleshooting steps on your own.
So can you process the return? I just want one that works, or my money back. This one seems defective.

I understand completely. For any product that might be defective, our required first step is to get you to our Technical Support team. They have specialized tools to diagnose the issue remotely. They can determine if it's a software problem they can fix right now, or if the hardware is indeed faulty and needs a replacement.
So you can't help me? I have to get transferred and explain this all over again? I don't have time for that.

I can assure you this is the fastest path. They are the only department that can authorize a warranty replacement for a defective device, which would be quicker than a standard return and repurchase. I can transfer you with my notes so you won't have to start from scratch.
Fine. If it's the fastest way, then do it.
Excellent. I'll connect you right now. Please hold for one moment while I conference them in.
